description:
List card campaigns

The current campaigns of Turkish credit-card programs — Wings, World, Bonus, Maximum and Axess — read daily from the programs' public campaign pages: installment offers, discounts, points (chip-para, Bonus, Worldpuan, MaxiPuan, miles) and prize draws, with the merchant, dates, amounts parsed from the headline, our sector tags and audience segments (student, traveler, driver, homemaker, …). Filter by `card`, `sector`, `segment`, `reward`, `brand`, a text search `q` (Turkish letters optional), and `ending_within` days; `status=ended` lists what ended in the last week. Soonest to end first. Use when the user asks what campaigns, discounts, installment offers or points their card has, for a shop or brand, for a kind of spending (market, fuel, travel, clothing), or for a kind of person; link the `url` for the terms — the program's page is authoritative.

GET /v1/deals/campaigns on Card Campaigns & Deals (SBX-FIRSAT). Costs 1 credit per call.

brand.description: A merchant name as it appears in `brand`, e.g. Trendyol (case-insensitive).

card.description: Comma-separated card program ids from /deals/cards, e.g. bonus,axess.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, with the same filters.

ending_within.description: Only active campaigns ending within this many days (1–60), soonest first.

q.description: Words to find at the start of words of the title, brand or summary; Turkish letters optional: `market`, `akaryakit`, `trendyol`.

reward.description: Comma-separated reward types (any of): installment, discount, points, draw, other.

sector.description: Comma-separated sector ids from /deals/sectors (any of), e.g. grocery,dining.

segment.description: Comma-separated segment ids from /deals/segments (any of), e.g. student,traveler.
